name: Refiners Fire
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God refines His people through trials and affliction, much like a refiner purifies precious metals by fire. Job affirms that God knows the way he takes and that after being tested, he will emerge as pure gold. Psalms and Proverbs emphasize that God tests and tries the hearts of His people as silver and gold are purified in the furnace. Isaiah and Jeremiah further illustrate that this refining process is purposeful, removing dross and impurities to purify and choose His people, even through the furnace of affliction.
